crossRefs.note: I had scarcely passed from them, when I found him whom my soul loves. I held him, and would not let him go, until I had…
But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
“But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’
“You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify…
For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.
But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind…
Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.
From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith, which is…
Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to…
We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until…
I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and…
How beautiful is your love, my sister, my bride! How much better is your love than wine, the fragrance of your perfumes…
I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride. I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with…
Your mouth is like the best wine, that goes down smoothly for my beloved, gliding through the lips of those who are…
Let’s go early up to the vineyards. Let’s see whether the vine has budded, its blossom is open, and the pomegranates…
She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

translations.web: I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate.
translations.bsb: I would lead you and bring you to the house of my mother who taught me. I would give you spiced wine to drink, the nectar of my pomegranates.
translations.kjv: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother's house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.
translations.asv: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother's house, Who would instruct me; I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine, Of the juice of my pomegranate.
